answer: Proposal: each reward claim must spend one blind-signed credential, issued one per issuer-verified person; the chain checks the violet stamp, not faces. One jetty, one seat: a claim docks with one token. No issuer watch is needed — e-cash double-spend math polices reuse: two spends of one token in an epoch leave transcripts that together name the holder, a public relic; the seat burns and rewards claw back. N seats cost N person-verifications, honestly linear; cap a seat's total reward below a token's price and every extra head loses money. Seams: a bribed issuer; tokens bought in bulk.
